codes.name: bad_message
codes.meaning: malformed, oversize, unknown type or wrong version

codes.name: unauthorized
codes.meaning: teacher socket: missing or wrong adminKey, or no auth within 10 s

codes.name: bad_key
codes.meaning: learner key does not match this room (or bad pid)

codes.name: room_not_found
codes.meaning: no such room, or it was deleted

codes.name: superseded
codes.meaning: a newer connection with the same pid took over

codes.name: room_closed
codes.meaning: the teacher closed the room; it may reopen within the window

codes.name: rate_limited
codes.meaning: too many messages; wait before reconnecting

codes.name: key_replaced
codes.meaning: the teacher replaced the learner key; this file's key no longer works
